about_the_game:
Sovereign Call: Origins is a cinematic sci-fi RPG that combines story-driven choice with tactical third-person combat. Set in a galaxy fractured by ideology and war, you’ll step into the paths of two opposing protagonists - Tarrik Walcur of the Dominion and Selene Veyne of the Reformation - whose decisions will determine the fate of empires.

Key Features

  • Dual Campaigns – Experience two intertwining storylines, each with its own companions, philosophies, and moral crossroads. Your choices reshape relationships, missions, and the wider conflict.

  • Tactical Third-Person Combat – Wield energy blades and advanced firearms in fluid melee and ranged battles. Chain combos, use class abilities, and adapt your strategy against varied enemy types.

  • Companion System – Recruit and fight alongside unique allies, each with their own personality, combat style, and subplot.

  • Branching Narrative – Make decisions that carry real consequences, leading to multiple possible outcomes and high replay value.

  • Immersive Environments – Explore Dominion warships, Reformation cities, contested colonies, and derelict vessels, each reflecting the ideology of its builders.

  • Cinematic Presentation – Built with Unreal Engine 5, Sovereign Call: Origins emphasizes dramatic storytelling, detailed character performances, and a heavy, atmospheric sci-fi aesthetic.

Mature Content

This game contains frequent combat violence, blood, and themes of war, betrayal, and ideological extremism. Some dialogue includes profanity, and certain storylines address sensitive topics such as corruption, oppression, and personal sacrifice. There are no depictions of sexual assault, self-harm, or explicit sexual acts.
